create_word_dropout_noiser: create a WordDropout instance to randomly drop words from tokenized sentences with a given dropout probability
create_word_shuffle_noiser: create a WordShuffle instance to shuffle words by no more than k positions in tokenized sentences
create_unsupervised_mt_noising: create an UnsupervisedMTNoising instance that applies word shuffle, dropout, and blanking noise to source tokens
create_noising_dataset: create a NoisingDataset wrapper that applies configurable noise to samples from a source dataset
review_word_noising_bpe: review the WordNoising base class and its BPE word index grouping logic for subword token handling
